titles.romaji: Kyou, Watashi no Monogatari ga Hashirimasu.
titles.native: 今日、わたしの物語が走ります。

description:
Commercial made for the JRA (Japan Racing Association). The tie-in track featured is “crossovers” by Aimer.

Note: A short 30 second version of the CM was initially uploaded on the JRA FUN YouTube Channel January 1st, 2023. The long ~2 minute version was released later on the JRA Official Channel and JRA FUN Twitter on April 8, 2023.
